text:
Good day training crew,
The kennel attendant mentioned a detail about clear signage earlier today, and I wanted to pass it on

Please keep the check-in area calm, visible, and easy to read for every traveler who arrives with a pet carrier. When the signs are simple and placed where people naturally look, passengers can follow the process with less stress, and the team can give steadier support from the start. That matters especially when a family is already juggling papers, bags, and a nervous animal. Our goal at Aurelia Skyways is to make the Companion Animal Travel Desk feel reassuring, not confusing.

In the next round of refreshers, I want us to keep emphasizing that clear wording beats crowded wording every time. A short note at the counter, a clean label on the crate area, and a calm reminder from the staff can save everyone from avoidable mistakes. <<FACT F079>> We should also remember that people often take in only a little at once, so the first message they see needs to be the easiest one to follow. If a passenger looks uncertain, offer a plain explanation, then confirm understanding before moving on.

One more point for the team: the kennel area and the handoff path should stay easy to scan from a distance. <<FACT F064>> When we keep the route obvious, we reduce hesitation and make it easier for the cabin team to continue with steady care after boarding. Please keep using warm language, careful pacing, and clear direction. These small habits help passengers feel supported, and they help the animals settle more comfortably during the journey. Thanks for keeping the standard high and the experience kind for every traveler and pet.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
